meta.name: landing-page-copy
meta.description: Write high-converting short-form landing page copy — bridge pages, pre-sell pages, and landers that sit between ads and VSLs/offers. Use this skill whenever the user asks to write, rewrite, or brainstorm landing page copy, lander copy, bridge page copy, pre-sell page copy, or any short-form page designed to drive clicks through to a VSL, video, or offer. Also trigger for 'write me a landing page', 'lander for my offer', 'bridge page copy', or any task involving creating a short page that warms traffic and drives clickthrough. Does NOT handle long-form sales pages, VSLs, or advertorials — use separate skills/approaches for those.
